how: Each row is one candidate of one scan, passed and rejected alike, in the order the scan stored them.

Premium is the net premium for selling one contract; underlying move is the expiry close below the strike times the multiplier, as in scoring. Their sum is the hold-to-expiry result, not realised P&L.
Assignment is only a state: in the money at expiry. The stock profit and loss after assignment belongs to the structure held and is not counted in this row.
